recommendation.summary: Mixed signals with a critical caveat: '123 Main St, 78701' is not a verifiable downtown Austin address (the downtown grid uses Congress/Brazos/Colorado/Lavaca/Guadalupe, not 'Main') — verify against TCAD before any binding action. Analysis runs against the modal 78701 downtown 1BR/1BA tower-condo profile at ~$725K. The neighborhood is elite (Walk Score 92, $162K median income, Google/Oracle/Meta employer base) and comps support a ~$650K mid-FMV for a 1BR, but the deal math is brutal as a leveraged investment: HOA ($600-1,200/mo) plus 2.07% property tax plus 7% rates means every LTR scenario bleeds ~$3,200-$3,800/month. Best fit is an appreciation-focused buyer with deep cash reserves and a 7-10 year hold, or a hard negotiator buying 15-20% under list. STR upside is largely dead post-July-2026 platform enforcement and HOA bans. Market is a deep buyer's market (127-day DOM, ~8.7-month supply, condos selling 4-4.3% under list).
recommendation.suggested_offer: Appreciation buyer w/ reserves: ≤$620K (1BR). Investor for cash flow: offer 15-20% under list ($560-595K) or walk.
